verdict.rationale: A SaaS equity and fund platform could plausibly offer a public API, so the axis applies, but the evidence shows no documented public API. Every documented workflow is UI navigation (e.g. 'navigate to Equity > Valuations, click Add'). The HRIS integrations, OCF/Excel exports and help-center llms.txt are adjacent features, not a programmatic API, and the OpenAPI/Swagger probe returned 404 on all candidate paths.
